what: Claude read a sensitive file in Claude skills (~/.claude/skills), then reached AWS 3 s later.

disposition.why: The Claude agent read its own bookmark-librarian skill config under ~/.claude/skills/synced/ and then made HTTPS connections to Cloudflare (2600:1f10:4fa9 / 2606:4700:20::), which is a standard API/CDN endpoint, not an exfiltration target.

actions.label: Allow this AWS address for claude
actions.consequence: Future connections from claude to 2600:1f10:4fa9:a02:3441:aad6:bb1a:fd73 are trusted and stop being flagged.

actions.label: Allow this Cloudflare address for claude
actions.consequence: Future connections from claude to 2606:4700:20::681a:4a4 are trusted and stop being flagged.

actions.label: Open incident report
actions.consequence: Shows the incident's remediation checklist with rotation advice; changes nothing.

actions.label: Dismiss this flag
actions.consequence: The flag is marked reviewed and stops counting as needing action; the rule keeps watching for the next one.
